title: bouch-audio
summary: Portable Bouch audio domain capability, DAW-independent. Consult for any audio creation, mixing or checking task before re-deriving audio technique or reaching into the REAPER workbenches: Skills for electronic production (sound design, bass, sub and kick, drum groove, arrangement, resampling), mixing and mastering boundaries, and audio verification (render measurement, verified offline sample edits, loudness-matched blind listening). Every claim is evidence-tiered and known gaps are listed rather than filled. Human listening decides musical quality.
